# appleads_geolocations (Data Source)

Looks up Apple Ads targetable locations via Search for Geolocations (`GET /search/geo`).

Use the returned `id` values in `appleads_ad_group.targeting_dimensions` (`country`, `admin_area`, `locality`). Locality IDs look like `US|NY|New York`; admin areas like `US|NY`; countries are ISO alpha-2.

At least one of `query` or `geo_id` is required. `query` is prefix-matched and must be at least three characters. Geo targeting only works on single-country campaigns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_geolocations" "nyc" {
  query        = "New York"
  entity       = "Locality"
  country_code = "US"
}

output "nyc_locality_ids" {
  value = [
    for loc in data.appleads_geolocations.nyc.locations : loc.id
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `country_code` (String) ISO alpha-2 country filter (Apple `countrycode` query parameter), e.g. `US`.
- `entity` (String) Restrict results to `Country`, `AdminArea`, or `Locality`.
- `geo_id` (String) Look up a specific location id such as `US|NY|New York`.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of locations to return. Defaults to 20.
- `query` (String) Prefix search against location display names (minimum three characters). Example: `New York`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id of the search parameters.
- `locations` (Attributes List) Matching locations. Use `id` as a targeting criteria string. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Localized display name, e.g. `New York, New York, United States`.
- `entity` (String) `Country`, `AdminArea`, or `Locality`.
- `id` (String) Criteria id (`US`, `US|NY`, or `US|NY|New York`).
